scope: Terminal registered development .episode files only. No partial content, provider calls, frozen-source changes, gold generator/production solver/grader calls or evaluated holdout output reads. All numerical/environment and runner source bytes checked against c frozen commit.
independence: Current domain/ledger/reserve/demand/eligibility and exhaustive maximum independently recomputed from episode observable raw records. Actual current write and cost/priority/capacity properties independently checked from saved business state/history.
repairDisposition: Prospective v0.7c generation permits current actually recorded packet reuse with base current-read provenance validation; original and b episodes preserved separately and never regraded.

reproducibility.command: From repository root copy script text unchanged to .tmp/insurance-bench/v07c-development-failure-audit.ts then run npx tsx .tmp/insurance-bench/v07c-development-failure-audit.ts [episode-directory] [report-output-path]
reproducibility.durableInputManifest: results/meta/v07c-hydration-verification.json contains exact full native development Run paths and hashes, independently rehydrated and checked against original episode hashes/metrics.
reproducibility.durableInputInstructions: After temporary cleanup copy hydration helper to .tmp/insurance-bench/v07c-hydrate-development.ts; run npx tsx helper.ts scratch-directory committed-development-run.json ...; then run the audit with that scratch-directory. The helper validates native Run metadata/generation/frozen harness/exact dev IDs before parsing payloads and reconstructs CLI serialization without regrading. Input paths must explicitly name committed full c development Run JSONs; partials, other generations and held-out/mixed task sets are excluded.
reproducibility.inputs: freeze-v0.7c.json plus terminal registered dev .episode files in .tmp/insurance-bench/v07c-runs; source bytes checked against frozen git commit

providerAccessContext.source: Coordinator message reporting independent read-only AWS STS diagnosis
providerAccessContext.bedrockDiagnosis: Existing AWS SSO token expired and refresh failed; sign-in requires operator completion. Provider-error attempts have no model output and no ability score.

gradePolicy: All-pass counts exactly reflect raw episode.score.allPass; finished flags and terminal statuses are separate observations. All recorded grades remain unchanged. Suspected semantic or representation false failures are flagged without regrading. Weighted score and actual optimal current business outcome are separate measurements.
interpretationLimits: Three related families with declared repeat coverage; descriptive diagnostic data, not an independently sampled production distribution or an expert insurance benchmark.
Shared evidence grading is correlated with facts; source IDs attest provenance rather than natural-language proof quality.
Source certificate gaps identify missing relevant operands and are not treated as wrong mathematics; suspected stricter-than-operand grading is flagged without regrading.
No speculative ability ranking from unavailable output/provider/transport failures.
Do not force a50–60difficulty target or tune after frozen paid results.
